# Empirical Gates Required Before Production Semantic Claims

The architecture may be frozen before these pass.
The operating semantic factory may not be called empirically certified until they do.

1. Build the benchmark corpus.
2. Execute source-first gold construction.
3. Benchmark free W1/W2 workers.
4. Benchmark Tier-B W3 specialists.
5. Certify at least one primary W2 role.
6. Certify at least one independent blind-recall role.
7. Certify required specialist roles or define explicit gaps.
8. Execute Machines real-source pilot.
9. Run union/precision/gate pipeline.
10. Run cold audit.
11. Run concurrency SAFE_4.
12. Run crash/restart test.
13. Run provider failover.
14. Run Buzz disconnect test or retain sidecar-only mode.
15. Run overnight soak.

Until then:
`PRODUCTION_SEMANTIC_STATUS = BLOCKED_PENDING_EMPIRICAL_GATES`.
